t: You're at Henley House, in Tower Hamlets, the birthplace of A. A. Milne. Alan Alexander Milne is best known for his books about the teddy bear Winnie-the-Pooh, and for his children's poetry. Before Pooh's huge success overshadowed his earlier work, he was primarily a playwright. He served as a lieutenant in the Royal Warwickshire Regiment in the First World War, and as a captain in the Home Guard in the Second World War.
